items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: He featured Sarah Martin that was his one of his feature singers

ctx.x: What about Clarence Williams? Was he a big man in Columbia and okay? When you knew him? What was his connection?

Well he had connections on all the records He featured Sarah Martin that was his one of his feature singers Sarah Martin and of course his wife done quite a bit Eva Taylor Eva Taylor she done quite a bit of records for him and with him But I used to work with him quite a bit in Chicago We worked at White City him and I together stuff with stuff

Irish Celtic Association, their big yearly event. I forget how many thousand people they told us was out there. And every music publisher in Chicago went out there to do a number, you know. Every song that they were plugging, you know, each company went out there to plug their number. So Clarence took me to go with him to plug his number, Royal Garden Blues. And when we got out there, he got stage fright. When he seen all them people out there, he started playing in another key. But I had been so used to singing,…
